questions.question: A tuck shop orders 24 boxes of chips at R35 a box. Write the number sentence, estimate, calculate and check against the story.
questions.expected_answer: Sentence: 24 times 35 equals box. Estimate: about 25 times 35, around 875. Calculate: 20 times 30 is 600, 20 times 5 is 100, 4 times 30 is 120, 4 times 5 is 20, total 840, so R840. Check: R840 for 24 boxes is about R35 a box, which fits.

questions.question: A recipe uses 2 cups of flour for every 3 vetkoek. Explain how to find the flour for 15 vetkoek and why both parts of the ratio change.
questions.expected_answer: 15 vetkoek is 3 times 5, so multiply both parts of the ratio by 5: 2 times 5 is 10 cups of flour for 15 vetkoek. Both parts must be multiplied by the same number so that the recipe stays in the same proportion.

questions.question: Explain the difference between a ratio and a rate, with one example of each, and work out how far a taxi travelling at 60 kilometres per hour goes in 3 hours.
questions.expected_answer: A ratio compares two amounts of the same kind, like 2 cups of flour to 3 vetkoek. A rate compares two different kinds per one unit, like 60 kilometres per hour. In 3 hours the taxi travels 3 times 60, which is 180 kilometres.
